name: hook-doordash-audit-log
description: Append-only audit log of every DoorDash CLI (dd-cli) invocation made through Claude Code. A PostToolUse hook records one versioned JSON line per dd-cli command (timestamp, session, cwd, command with tokens stripped, event type derived from the command itself - search / cart_mutation / checkout_ur...
